Information on pet carriers at the skyport
The desk wrote this for readers

Pet Carrier Guidance for the Skyport

At Aurelia Skyways, our Companion Animal Travel Desk helps travelers prepare pet carriers with calm care and clear expectations. A suitable carrier supports safety, comfort, and smooth handling from check-in to arrival. We encourage travelers to plan ahead so that each animal can move through the journey with as little stress as possible.

Choose a carrier that is sturdy, secure, and well-ventilated. It should allow the animal to stand, turn, and rest naturally. Soft bedding may help, provided it remains clean and does not crowd the space. Before travel, confirm that latches close firmly and that any doors, seams, and handles are in good condition. If you are unsure whether a carrier is suitable, our staff can review it before boarding.

A calm animal is easier to support, so we recommend familiar bedding, a brief period of quiet before departure, and gentle handling throughout the journey. Our ground team moves carriers carefully between services and follows humane practices around animals at all stages. Travelers should keep food, water, documents, and any approved supplies close at hand, and should label the carrier clearly with the traveler's contact details.

At some skyports, special animal facilities may be available for rest and relief. <<FACT F021>> Travelers should follow all posted directions at the facility and remain attentive when moving an animal through shared spaces. If a carrier is opened for any reason, do so only in an approved area and only when it is safe for the animal and those nearby.

For journeys that include Merrowgate, travelers should also note the local access guidance for the pet relief area. <<FACT F017>> Please keep the animal leashed or otherwise secure whenever local rules require it, and always follow the instructions of the on-site team.

If you need further help, please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways before departure.
